name: I Power Left
purpose: Power to the weak side. The flanker is not out there to help, so the kick-out and the wrap have to be clean — but their defense is usually leaning the other way.

RE.rule: Cut off pursuit from behind. You are the last one to the ball, so never quit on the play.

RT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you — nobody crosses your face.

RG.rule: PULL LEFT. Run flat behind the line and turn up in the open gap between our tackle and our end. Block the first wrong-colored jersey you see.

C.rule: You have the nose, head up on you. Hands inside and do not let him cross your face to the playside.

LG.rule: Nobody is over you. Help the center drive the nose for one count, then climb to the middle linebacker.

LT.rule: The tackle is on your inside shoulder. Block him down and seal him inside — that is what opens the hole.

LE.rule: Release inside off his outside shoulder and take the playside linebacker. The end over you is being kicked out — leave him alone.

Z.rule: Come across behind the line and cut off anybody chasing from the backside.

QB.rule: Reverse pivot, hand the ball to the tailback deep, then carry out the bootleg fake away from the play.

FB.rule: Kick out the end. Aim at his inside hip and run through him — do not stop your feet.

TB.rule: Take the handoff, press the outside hip of our tackle, then turn up inside the pulling guard.

coaching_points: Check their alignment first. If they have shaded toward our flanker, this is the call.
The flanker chases from behind. Tell him he is not decoration — he cuts off the corner who would otherwise run this down.
Everything else is I Power Right in a mirror. Teach the pair together.
